sloka: श्रुत्वैव वचनं यन्मे राघवं पतिमिच्छथ ।राजानः संशयोऽयं मे तदिदं ब्रूत तत्त्वतः ॥२-२-२४॥
transliteration: śrutvaiva vacanaṁ yanme rāghavaṁ patimicchatha ।rājānaḥ saṁśayo'yaṁ me tadidaṁ brūta tattvataḥ ॥2-2-24॥

translations.english: O kings, soon after listening to my words, all of you wish Rama to be king. (But) I doubt (in my mind) whether you have said it from your heart৷৷
